# What Crystal Stones is, as objects

Crystal Stones is a project that issues a BEP-20 token on BNB Smart Chain and describes itself as a Real World Asset effort. The academy is a school. The token is a list. The backing is a claim. If you mash those into one glowing word, you will pay somebody for a feeling.

By the end of this lesson you should be able to say three sentences: what the token is, what the academy is, and what backing means before anyone has shown you a vault.

## The token is a BEP-20 list

On BNB Smart Chain, chain ID 56, a contract keeps balances. The public contract this academy teaches you to verify is 0xe252FCb1Aa2E0876E9B5f3eD1e15B9b4d11A0b00. Verification means: you open a bookmarked explorer, you paste that string, you confirm you are on BSC mainnet, you read the code and the holders. Verification is not a purchase. It is not a payment. Sending units to that address is how people park value in a program that did not offer them a checkout.

## The academy is a school

Crystal Stones Academy teaches ledgers, keys, safety, Ethereum-style programs, DeFi, tokenomics, markets, NFTs, DAOs, and RWA pictures. Basic is free. Intermediate is a paid track. Advanced is labelled later. The school will not tell you to buy the token. A school that requires you to buy the mascot to learn is a sales room. This one uses USDT BEP-20 for Intermediate tuition on the academy checkout page.

## Backing is a claim

The project describes backing by tangible assets, primarily solid minerals, with additional exposure to real estate and petroleum. A claim is a sentence that wants evidence: custody, title, audits with dates, redemption rules. This lesson will not fake that evidence. RWA specialization already taught you the four objects. Apply them here without fan mail.

TABLE
Drawer | Object | Not
Token | BEP-20 at the named contract on BSC | A vault of rocks
Academy | Lessons, quizzes, checkout, mentor | A DEX
Backing | A claim about minerals, property, petroleum | Something the EVM can see
Tuition | USDT BEP-20 on the academy page | The Crystal Stones ticker
ENDTABLE

**Worked scenario.** A site says ‘Crystal Stones is backed, so pay the academy in CST.’ You refuse. Backing, if evidenced, still does not make the token the tuition rail. Checkout is USDT BEP-20. Staff will not DM a token address. The contract is verify-only.

[ BEP-20 list ] [ School ] [ Backing claim ]

# Published figures as claims

Figures associated with Crystal Stones include a total supply around 135,000,000 and a circulating supply around 104,100,000, and a deflationary story with burns on transfers. Intermediate’s job is to treat each figure as something to check, not as a chant.

By the end of this lesson you should know where to look and what would falsify a figure.

## Total supply

Read totalSupply() on the contract. If it can mint, today’s number is not forever. If it burns, today’s number can fall. Record the date you read it. Numbers in this lesson can go stale. The method does not.

## Circulating

Usually a dashboard: total minus labelled locks. Check those locks. If a ‘locked’ wallet can move, circulating is understated. If dead addresses hold units, some dashboards subtract them.

## Burns

Find the burn path: a tax, a burn(), a send to dead. Measure whether mint outruns it. ‘Deflationary’ is a net, as tokenomics taught.

TABLE
Figure | Where to check | Falsifier
Total ~135M | totalSupply() | A different number on the contract
Circulating ~104.1M | Holders + lockers | Moveable ‘locked’ wallets
Burns | Transfer tax / burn() | Owner mint larger than burns
ENDTABLE

**Worked scenario.** A year-old infographic still circulates. You do not argue from memory. You read the contract today. You still do not buy because a number matched. Education only.

# Decimals and units

Decimals decide how a raw integer becomes a display amount. Misread decimals and you misread every transfer. Read decimals() on the contract.

By the end of this lesson you should be able to teach the title — Decimals and units — without a marketing slide.

## The object

Decimals decide how a raw integer becomes a display amount. Misread decimals and you misread every transfer. Read decimals() on the contract. Intermediate treats this as an object with a contract, a function, and an explorer row. If you cannot point at those, you have a vibe. Global learners get the same objects. There is no local exception.

## How you check it

Open the bookmarked explorer on the named chain. Read the function names. Read the roles. Read timestamps on vesting if any. Do not use a search ad. Do not use a chat screenshot as evidence. Evidence is the chain and the verified source, with the caveat that verified is a compiler match, not an audit.

## How it fails

It fails when an admin path exists that the slide omitted, when a tax flips, when a vest is only a labelled EOA, or when someone asks you to skip the explorer because ‘the community already checked.’ Communities are not bytecode.

## What this academy will not do

We will not tell you this object is a reason to buy Crystal Stones or anything else. We will not take tuition in Crystal Stones. We will not ask for a seed to ‘apply tokenomics.’ Staff do not DM unlock calendars that require a payment.

TABLE
Check | Honest | Costume
cst contract function | Named in source and explorer | A PNG
Admin | Listed with address | ‘Renounced’ with a live proxy
Time | A timestamp you can read | ‘Soon’
Money | USDT checkout on the academy page | A token dump address
ENDTABLE

You verify Crystal Stones at 0xe252FCb1Aa2E0876E9B5f3eD1e15B9b4d11A0b00 if the claim is about that token. You verify the other contract if it is about another token. You are not a fund. You are not the warehouse. You are a learner who can refuse a mash-up. That is the $10 worth on this module.

By the end of this lesson you should be able to teach the title — After this course — without a marketing slide.

## The object

You are not a fund. You are not the warehouse. You are a learner who can refuse a mash-up. That is the $10 worth on this module. Intermediate treats this as an object with a contract, a function, and an explorer row. If you cannot point at those, you have a vibe. Global learners get the same objects. There is no local exception.

## How you check it

Open the bookmarked explorer on the named chain. Read the function names. Read the roles. Read timestamps on vesting if any. Do not use a search ad. Do not use a chat screenshot as evidence. Evidence is the chain and the verified source, with the caveat that verified is a compiler match, not an audit.

## How it fails

It fails when an admin path exists that the slide omitted, when a tax flips, when a vest is only a labelled EOA, or when someone asks you to skip the explorer because ‘the community already checked.’ Communities are not bytecode.

## What this academy will not do

We will not tell you this object is a reason to buy Crystal Stones or anything else. We will not take tuition in Crystal Stones. We will not ask for a seed to ‘apply tokenomics.’ Staff do not DM unlock calendars that require a payment.

TABLE
Check | Honest | Costume
cst practice function | Named in source and explorer | A PNG
Admin | Listed with address | ‘Renounced’ with a live proxy
Time | A timestamp you can read | ‘Soon’
Money | USDT checkout on the academy page | A token dump address
ENDTABLE

**Worked scenario.** You are shown a cst practice claim next to a Crystal Stones logo. You split the logo from the claim. You verify Crystal Stones at 0xe252FCb1Aa2E0876E9B5f3eD1e15B9b4d11A0b00 if the claim is about that token. You verify the other contract if it is about another token. You pay Intermediate only as USDT BEP-20 on the academy page.

DIAGRAM
SLIDE: After this course
   |
   v
EXPLORER: function + role + time
   |
   v
YOU: write one sentence that still works if the website dies
ENDDIAGRAM

NOTE
Academy rule: if it cannot be named as a function, it is not tokenomics yet.
ENDNOTE

Global standard: a learner in any country should be able to repeat this lesson with the same contract and the same checkout rails. After this course does not change at a border.


## Academy rails (same on every lesson)

Crystal Stones as a token is a BEP-20 on BNB Smart Chain. The public contract to **verify** is `0xe252FCb1Aa2E0876E9B5f3eD1e15B9b4d11A0b00`. That string is not a buy order, not a payment address, and not gas. Gas on BSC is BNB. Intermediate tuition is $10 USDT BEP-20 through academy checkout, never Crystal Stones token, never a chat 0x.

This academy will not tell you to buy, farm, or hold Crystal Stones. Pairing a token with it does not bless the other token. Academy staff never ask for a seed phrase, a private key, 2FA codes, or remote screen control.

## Global check 1

A learner anywhere should be able to repeat **After this course** with the same chain ID, the same contract string if the lesson names Crystal Stones, and the same checkout rail. Borders do not change bytecode. Slang does not change a mint function. A local chat app does not become support because it used a logo.

If this lesson named a number, date-stamp it when you read it on the explorer. Lesson text goes stale. Methods do not. Intermediate tuition stays $10 USDT BEP-20 through academy checkout. Crystal Stones at `0xe252FCb1Aa2E0876E9B5f3eD1e15B9b4d11A0b00` stays verify-only.

## Global check 2

A learner anywhere should be able to repeat **After this course** with the same chain ID, the same contract string if the lesson names Crystal Stones, and the same checkout rail. Borders do not change bytecode. Slang does not change a mint function. A local chat app does not become support because it used a logo.

If this lesson named a number, date-stamp it when you read it on the explorer. Lesson text goes stale. Methods do not. Intermediate tuition stays $10 USDT BEP-20 through academy checkout. Crystal Stones at `0xe252FCb1Aa2E0876E9B5f3eD1e15B9b4d11A0b00` stays verify-only.

## What this lesson is for

So the object in the title is something you can name on an explorer, not a slogan on a slide.

## Say this out loud
- After this course is a checkable object.
- Explorer first, slide second.
- Admin paths count.
- Crystal Stones is verify-only.
- Tuition is USDT BEP-20, not a ticker.
